args.message: Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` was using `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but per FIN-212 it must use banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail on `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even` (e.g. `2.665` must round to `2.66`, not `2.67`).

## Change
- `src/money.py`: switch rounding mode from `ROUND_HALF_UP` to `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` to match the documented FIN-212 requirement.

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on `fix/bankers-rounding-fin-212` @ `08d3cd5986`: **passed**, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
